title: Proof of the Noferini-Williams conjecture for Gilbert-Howie groups
summary: The Gilbert-Howie groups $H(n,m)$ form a notable subclass within the broader family of Fibonacci-type cyclically presented groups $G_n(m,k)$. Noferini and Williams conjectured that the abelianization $H(n,m)^{ab}$ is torsion-free with $\mathbb{Z}$-rank $2$ if and only if $n\equiv 0\pmod{6}$ and $m\equiv 2\pmod{n}$. We confirm this conjecture by proving that $\mathrm{Res}(F,G)=\pm1$, where $F=(1+t^m-t)/Φ_6$ and $G=(t^n-1)/Φ_6$, with $Φ_6$ denoting the sixth cyclotomic polynomial. The proof uses a minimality argument, reducing the general problem to three cases: $m=2+n/3$, $m=2+n/2$, and…
